rationale: Hapax in this corpus. Context (paired with 'seal' and 'new character/χαρακτήρ') demands a noun for stamp/mold/exemplar. Possibly related to ϩⲟ 'face/image,' or a specialized Lycopolitan term for an imprinted likeness. Adam bearing a 'ϩⲟⲩⲣ of seal' parallels the icon of the Ambassador imprinted upon him.

Latin patrōnia / Greek πατρωνία. Manichaean technical term here for the heavenly powers' protective patronage extended to Adam (and through him to the molded ones) on account of the imprinted icon of the Ambassador. Standard juridical-protective semantics.

Qualitative form of the same root as ⲡⲗⲁⲍⲗⲉⲍ 'lust' already in glossary. Modifies the Ambassador's icon: 'he is desire-arousing in his likeness beyond all creatures.' Active-causative quality: not merely beautiful but inciting desire — fits the Manichaean Third Ambassador's seductive-redemptive function over the archons.
Parsed as Lyc. ⲟⲩⲛ̄-ⲁ- (existential + future) + ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'reveal forth.' The reduced ⲟⲩⲁ for ⲟⲩⲛ̄ⲁ is dialectal. Construction: 'there shall be revealed in him all the arts.'
